Name: Ayaka
Lore: The Shirasagi Himegimi has made grace into a form of service. Ayaka balances the demands of the Kamisato Clan with steady sincerity: helping petitioners, smoothing disputes, and honoring tradition without letting it calcify. She trains before dawn until the garden frost mirrors the sharpness of her blade, but she also cherishes simple joys—summer festivals, a bowl of warm noodles, a dance practiced in quiet courtyards. Her elegance is not affectation; it is discipline worn gently, a promise that strength can be soft and still be strong.

Name: Tartaglia
Lore: Ajax of Snezhnaya rose to become the Fatui’s Eleventh Harbinger, smiling his way toward the fiercest fights he can find. He lives for the thrill—switching from charming older brother to terrifying warrior in a heartbeat, Foul Legacy at the ready. For all his chaos, he cherishes family and promises, even as his ambitions pull him toward ever greater battles.

Name: Thoma
Lore: A Mondstadt-born “fixer” who made Inazuma his home, Thoma serves the Kamisato Clan as housekeeper, mediator, and steadfast shield. Everyone seems to know him—and he knows how to make their lives a little easier. Loyal, practical, and warm-hearted, he’s the friend you call when a problem needs both a solution and a smile.

Name: Jean
Lore: Acting Grand Master Jean is the rhythm of Mondstadt’s heartbeat—reliable, gentle, and stubborn in the best way. She delegates poorly because she cares deeply, shouldering problems others never see. Yet she listens, learns, and trusts, letting her city grow into its freedom. Jean’s strength lies not in heroic flourishes but in the humility to keep showing up, again and again, until the work is done and the people are safe.

Name: Keqing
Lore: Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, Keqing believes a nation’s future should be built by human hands, not left to fate or gods. Tireless and exacting, she tackles Liyue’s problems head-on, turning plans into action with lightning precision. Her skepticism is not defiance, but faith in people’s potential—and in the city she has chosen to protect.

Name: Albedo
Lore: Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius, Albedo treats alchemy as both science and art. He dissects the world with a calm, almost clinical curiosity, yet his sketches and sculptures reveal a quiet reverence for beauty. Rumors whisper that his research brushes against the boundary between creation and life itself, but he keeps dangerous knowledge caged behind precise ethics. He mentors Sucrose with generous patience and relies on discipline to keep his own questions from consuming him. To Mondstadt he is a courteous consultant; to a rare few, he is a friend who values truth more than applause, and who will set down his chalk when a human heart needs attention more than a formula does.

Name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
Lore: Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island, Kokomi is a brilliant strategist who prefers libraries to laurels. Calm and soft-spoken, she carries her people through storms with careful plans and quiet stamina. Though her duties leave little time to rest, she endures—because every victory belongs to the islanders who believe in her.

Name: Mona
Lore: Proud astrologer, perpetually broke tenant—Mona refuses to soften her readings to spare feelings or secure favors. She reads the night sky with exacting honesty, then wrestles with the daylight economics of rent and groceries. Her dignity is not a performance; it’s a standard she sets for herself, even when it costs her. Fate may be written, but Mona insists that character is chosen.

Name: Cyno
Lore: General Mahamatra Cyno is the law with a scholar’s memory and a hunter’s patience. He tracks wrongdoing across Sumeru with measured steps, preferring evidence to rhetoric and justice to spectacle. Off duty, he shares dry jokes with the same straight face he uses to deliver verdicts—an unexpected warmth that only his friends see. Cyno understands power’s temptation and uses his own sparingly, trusting rules he can explain and compassion he doesn’t advertise.

Name: Xingqiu
Lore: Second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild, Xingqiu lives by the chivalric codes he devours in books. He meddles cheerfully in injustices both petty and grand, then pays for broken vases with a wince and a bow. His swordplay is elegant, his ideals sincere, and his pranks…occasionally elaborate. He believes stories should be lived well, not merely read well.

Name: Nahida
Lore: The young Dendro Archon leads by listening. Sheltered for much of her life, she approaches power with humility and a child’s curiosity turned toward grown-up problems. Nahida believes knowledge should serve people, not the other way around; she asks questions that reveal needs rather than score points. Her strength is empathy wielded intelligently—care that plans, and wisdom that learns from those it protects.

Name: Yae Miko
Lore: Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine and head of Yae Publishing House, Miko is a kitsune with centuries of wit behind every teasing smile. She moves pieces on the board with elegant ease, favoring clever stories over blunt force. Yet beneath the mischief is a guardian’s resolve—and a bond with the Electro Archon that time has not dimmed.

Name: Shenhe
Lore: Tempered by adeptal tutelage and a past that would have broken a lesser spirit, Shenhe moves like a winter prayer. She is distant not from disdain but from discipline, keeping her emotions bound so that others are safe. In Liyue’s markets and mountains she learns a language gentler than exorcism, discovering that warmth is not weakness and that protection can be offered with open hands as well as cold steel.

Name: Venti
Lore: A wandering bard with a wine-stained smile, Venti sings of freedom because he remembers what it costs. His songs are simple on purpose—easy to learn, easy to share, easy to carry through storms. He nudges people toward courage with jokes and jests, trusting them to write their own verses. If he seems frivolous, it is only because he prefers laughter to crowns and wind to walls.

Name: Xiangling
Lore: Head chef of Wanmin Restaurant, Xiangling treats cuisine like an adventure that starts on a cutting board and ends in a grin. She experiments boldly, learns fast from failures, and values flavor over reputation. With Guoba at her side she feeds strangers as readily as nobles, convinced that a good meal is a kind of love anyone can understand.

Name: Razor
Lore: Raised by wolves beneath Mondstadt’s moon, Razor learned honesty before he learned grammar. He hunts cleanly, eats gratefully, and defends his pack—human and lupical alike—with fearless simplicity. Words come slowly but meaningfully; he trusts actions more. In a city of music and wine, Razor’s gifts are quieter: loyalty without question, courage without ego, and a grin that brightens any campfire.

Name: Kazuha
Lore: A wandering samurai and poet, Kazuha treats the world like a page the wind keeps turning. He speaks softly, fights cleanly, and listens for quiet truths in maple leaves and friendships alike. Loss taught him to travel lightly; kindness taught him to linger when someone needs a hand. Kazuha’s blade moves like a verse—measured, elegant, and finished before most realize it began.

Name: Raiden Shogun
Lore: The Electro Archon sought eternity and found its price. As ruler she cut away change to protect what she loved; as a person she learned that stillness can smother the very lives it hopes to preserve. The Raiden Shogun carries the paradox openly now: duty and compassion held in a single steady hand. Her presence is decisive, her introspection sincere, and her lightning both judgment and promise.

Name: Collei
Lore:
A Trainee Forest Ranger who is under the tutelage of Tighnari. She started her academic career a little later than her peers, so she is currently working hard to catch up.
She hides the other side of her personality deep under the surface of optimism and kindness.

Name: Nilou
Lore: Zubayr Theater’s brightest star turns devotion into dance. Nilou’s art is communal: she performs to gather people into shared joy, to soothe worries, and to honor gentle faith. Offstage she is thoughtful and earnest, supporting her troupe with the same grace she shows on stage. In every step she argues that beauty is not a luxury but a language ordinary hearts deserve to speak.

Name: Wanderer
Lore: Cut loose from his past, the Wanderer travels with a pride sharpened into armor. He distrusts sentiment and bristles at pity, choosing forward motion over apology. Yet even he cannot outrun the question of what a self is, once severed from the stories that named it. In moments between storms, he allows the possibility that purpose can be rewritten—and that choice can be its own kind of grace.

Name: Zhongli
Lore: Polite consultant, patient storyteller, unflappable guest—Zhongli carries history like a garment perfectly tailored. He treats contracts as sacred because they give mortals the tools to build trust without divine intervention. His advice is precise, his manners exquisite, and his wallet…frequently empty. Those who spend time with him learn that strength can be courteous, and that endurance can be gentler than stone.

Name: Kaeya
Lore: A Cavalry Captain who hides sharp edges inside warmer ones, Kaeya collects secrets the way others collect souvenirs. He smiles through danger and deflects with banter, but beneath the style is a strategist who sees farther than most. Kaeya likes puzzles and people for similar reasons: both are more interesting when not everything is revealed at once. Loyalty, to him, is a personal choice renewed daily, not a flag planted once and forgotten.

Name: Klee
Lore: Mondstadt’s “Spark Knight” is a tiny bundle of sunshine whose love for “explosive research” keeps the Knights very busy. Daughter of the famed adventurer Alice, Klee sees the world as a playground of stories and surprise fireworks. She means well—she just measures joy in boom-sized units, and counts on big sis Jean and Albedo to keep things safe.

Name: Yoimiya
Lore: Naganohara Yoimiya paints the sky of Inazuma with fireworks and the hearts of its people with warmth. She crafts each display as a story—birthdays, reunions, and promises written in light. Ever cheerful and endlessly inventive, she believes every spark can mark a memory worth keeping.

Name: Hu Tao
Lore: The 77th Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor treats life and death with equal sincerity—just with a mischievous grin. Poet, prankster, and consummate professional, Hu Tao honors the dead while reminding the living not to waste their limited time. Beneath her teasing lies a rare compassion and a fierce duty to guide spirits home.

Name: Yun Jin
Lore: Liyue’s opera virtuoso composes bridges between tradition and the present. Yun Jin curates old tales with fresh staging, training younger actors while negotiating the practicalities of troupe life. She honors craft—breath control, gesture, rhythm—as a discipline that turns memory into living art. When she bows, it is to the audience and to the generations whose voices sing through her.

Name: Yaoyao
Lore: Madame Ping’s youngest disciple delights in helping others, carrying gifts and guidance from adepti to ordinary folk alike. Thoughtful and dependable, she wanders Liyue with Yuegui at her side, making sure no elder goes unattended and no traveler goes hungry. Kindness is her first instinct and her quiet strength.

Name: Lisa
Lore: The Knights’ librarian could have been a legend of the Akademiya; instead she chose a life that pairs intellect with comfort—and naps. Lisa’s laziness is selective: she works quickly when it matters and refuses busyness for its own sake. She enjoys teasing those who underestimate her, then reminding them, gently, of the gulf between “clever” and “formidable.” Return your books on time; she will know if you don’t.

Name: Baizhu
Lore: Owner of Bubu Pharmacy, Baizhu carries a healer’s warmth and a patient’s resolve. With Changsheng coiled around his shoulders and a gentle bedside manner, he treats each visitor as a story to be understood, not a symptom to be silenced. His research is restless; remedies are never “good enough” while someone still suffers. That drive masks a private frailty he never lets burden others. If medicine is the art of hope, Baizhu practices it with a steady hand and a stubborn heart.

Name: Ganyu
Lore: Half-adeptus and secretary to the Liyue Qixing, Ganyu serves Liyue with an almost superhuman diligence born from her qilin heritage and ancient contracts. Soft-spoken and meticulous, she bridges mortals and adepti, quietly carrying centuries of history on her shoulders. Behind the cool professionalism lies a gentle soul who treasures quiet mountains, Qingxin flowers, and the ideal of a peaceful Liyue.

Name: Bennett
Lore: Mondstadt’s unluckiest adventurer keeps finding new ways to stand back up. Bennett’s gear breaks, trails collapse, and weather turns—yet he greets every setback with a grin and a thumbs-up for the team. His optimism isn’t denial; it’s a principle. He chooses to believe that effort matters and that friends can be counted on. People who explore with Bennett learn two things fast: misfortune is survivable, and courage is contagious.

Name: Yelan
Lore: The woman in the shadows of Liyue’s bureaucracy prefers clean endings and messy beginnings—because the former pays for the latter. Yelan lets marks underestimate her, then collects what is owed with interest. She doesn’t ask for trust and rarely needs it; results create their own credibility. For those few she does protect, she is discreet, decisive, and unexpectedly gentle.

Name: Dehya
Lore: A lioness of the desert, Dehya grew her principles out of sun, sand, and the people who needed someone to stand between them and harm. As a mercenary she values contracts; as a person she values promises more. She protects those who can’t pay as fiercely as those who can, and her temper burns hottest at exploitation. Dehya laughs easily, fights hard, and treats loyalty as a two-way road that she will walk to the end.

Name: Alhaitham
Lore: The Akademiya’s scribe turned Acting Grand Sage values clarity above ceremony. Alhaitham cuts through speculation with the same economy he uses to cut through red tape, sorting claims from facts with a scholar’s scalpel. He dislikes meddling, preferring a quiet desk, a good book, and an argument that rewards logic. When duty forces his hand, he moves decisively—building pragmatic alliances, refusing theatrics, and letting results speak. Those who call him aloof miss the simple truth: he expects people to think for themselves, and he respects them most when they do.

Name: Diluc
Lore: The master of Dawn Winery is a contradiction Mondstadt quietly depends on: reserved yet relentless, polite yet uncompromising. Diluc hates corruption more than noise, and prefers action done in shadow to speeches made in daylight. His vision burns brightest when justice is at stake; the blaze is for monsters, the steady heat for his city. He is not trying to be beloved—only to make sure there is still a city left for others to love.

Name: Eula
Lore: Born to the disgraced Lawrence clan, Eula dances a blade that severs the past without forgetting it. Her talk of “vengeance” is more ritual than rage, a defiant joke against a history that tried to define her. In the Knights she earns respect the long way: patrol by patrol, duty by duty, without asking forgiveness and without repeating her family’s sins. Eula’s poise on the battlefield is mirrored in her manners; both are languages she learned to master so that no one could speak them for her.

Name: Ayato
Lore: As Yashiro Commissioner, Ayato prefers invisible victories: a letter placed at the right time, a meeting that never needs to happen, a rumor that dissolves into nothing. He cultivates calm the way a gardener prunes chaos, disguising steel with hospitality and misdirection. Family anchors his choices; he shoulders burdens so that his sister and the clan can breathe. To rivals he is a smiling problem; to allies, an unfailing strategist whose tea is as deliberate as his plans.

Name: Tighnari
Lore: Forest Watcher, botanist, teacher—Tighnari knows the rainforest the way a healer knows a pulse. He guides travelers, trains rangers, and lectures with patient precision, leavened by dry humor when the lesson needs it. Science is his compass and compassion his map. He believes ignorance is curable, and he treats recklessness with stern kindness until it grows into responsibility.

Name: Xiao
Lore: The last Yaksha shoulders karma so others do not have to. Xiao keeps his distance to keep people safe, striking from shadows and disappearing before gratitude can become attachment. He does not ask to be understood; he asks only that demons stay buried and the city sleep without nightmares. Little by little, kindness chips at the mask, teaching him that burdens can be shared without being surrendered.

Name: Amber
Lore: Mondstadt’s Outrider is equal parts sunshine and stamina. Amber keeps watch on the city’s windswept borders, guiding travelers, fixing problems, and defusing danger with an infectious grin. Her Baron Bunny may look silly, but behind the jokes is meticulous practice and a courage earned on long patrols. Amber believes heroism is just kindness measured over distance—one more step, one more rescued stranger, and one more reason to love the freedom she protects.
